description.zh:
业务隔离ID，用于同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据隔离。

><notice>
用户和用户组，必须在同一个隔离ID下。请与调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户，和调用[AddFaceUserGroup](~~288341~~)接口创建用户组时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
></notice>
description.en:
The business isolation ID, which is used for data isolation between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account.

><notice>
The user and the user group must be under the same isolation ID. Set this parameter to the same value as the **IsolationId** that you specified when you called the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation to add the user and the [AddFaceUserGroup](~~288341~~) operation to create the user group.
></notice>.

description.zh: 用户组ID。请传入在调用[AddFaceUserGroup](~~288341~~)接口创建用户组后，获取并保存到本地的用户组ID。
description.en: The user group ID. Set this parameter to the user group ID that you obtained and saved locally after calling the [AddFaceUserGroup](~~288341~~) operation to create the user group.

description.zh: 用户ID。请传入在调用[AddFaceUser](~~288338~~)接口添加用户后，获取并保存到本地的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID. Set this parameter to the user ID that you obtained and saved locally after calling the [AddFaceUser](~~288338~~) operation to add the user.

title.en: Add a user to a user group

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。
    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Before you begin
The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) per Alibaba Cloud account for this operation is 100.
    > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
